name: dfifo S1 characterisation
notes:
Committed before any dfifo campaign ran. B comes from the transition kernel, not from observed seeds; theory.py was solved first and the RTL written afterwards.
The initial-state distribution is committed because it selects the question: cold start measures first passage, stationary start measures recurrence of a rare state. Reporting one as the other would be a category error, so both run.
FALSIFIABLE IN A WAY THE EARLIER BOARDS WERE NOT: the kernel predicts a full first-passage distribution, four level milestones scaling as k^2, and P(T_hit <= B) = 0.630. Any of those can come out wrong, and if they do the board is broken rather than uninteresting. Extending B or redrawing the stimulus to rescue a disagreement is the Experiment 15 refusal wearing a different hat.

spec.activation: iff occupancy reaches DEPTH; designs bit-identical below it

admission.coherence: detection occurs iff the occupancy reaches DEPTH
admission.positive_control: good DUT passes on every seed in every condition
admission.stimulus_identity: T_hit must agree between variants on the same seed

spec.budget_derivation: ceil(E[T_hit | q0=0]) by exact linear solve, computed before the RTL existed

conditions.control: q0 ~ Uniform{0..24}, the exact stationary law (recurrence)

spec.design: dfifo — depth-24 FIFO, balanced push/pop occupancy walk
